panels.h3: 20 x 8 ft G+1: 320 sq ft From a 160 sq ft Footprint
panels.paragraph: This is the smallest approved stack and the one that saves the most ground. Each floor is a single open office of 160 sq ft with three workstations along Wall B and three ceiling cabinets above them. A clear centre aisle runs the length, and both end bays stay free of furniture. One door per floor sits mid way along Wall A, with a window each side of it. Pick it when the gate area is small and six desks are enough.
applications: Rs 4,71,200 ex GST, Rs 5,56,016 with 18 per cent GST
160 sq ft per floor, 320 sq ft gross, two stacked 8 ft bands
6 windows and 1 external door per floor, both end walls solid
3 workstations per floor, 6 in total, 6 ceiling cabinets

panels.h3: 20 x 16 ft G+1: A Fully Serviced Floor, Repeated Twice
panels.paragraph: Widen the same 20 ft length to 16 ft and each floor gains its own service core. You get four workstations, a six seat discussion table, a 5 x 6 ft pantry, a gents WC, a ladies WC and a shared wash. All of it repeats upstairs, so neither floor depends on the other for a toilet or a kettle. The service end stays solid, with two high level louvres per floor and no window. Choose it when each floor must run alone.
applications: Rs 9,12,640 ex GST, Rs 10,76,915 with 18 per cent GST
320 sq ft per floor, 640 sq ft gross, four stacked 8 ft bands
5 windows and 1 external door per floor, service end solid
4 workstations and one 6 seat discussion table per floor
Pantry, gents, ladies and shared wash on both levels

panels.h3: 40 x 8 ft G+1: A Manager Room on Each of Two Floors
panels.paragraph: Same 640 sq ft gross as the 20 x 16, but laid out long and narrow instead. Each floor holds a 10 x 8 ft manager room at the End C end and a 30 x 8 ft common office behind it. Seven workstations run in one line along Wall B, each with a cabinet above. Two doors per floor open onto Wall A, so staff and visitors need not share one entry. Pick this when a closed room matters more than a wide floor. Both floors run the identical plan, so the upstairs manager gets the same room.
applications: Rs 9,12,640 ex GST, Rs 10,76,915 with 18 per cent GST
320 sq ft per floor, 640 sq ft gross, two stacked 8 ft bands
9 windows and 2 external doors per floor, both end walls glazed

panels.h3: 40 x 16 ft G+1: Manager, Conference and a Wet Core
panels.paragraph: At 640 sq ft per floor the plan finally holds two closed rooms and a service bay together. Each level gives a 10 x 8 ft manager room and a 10 x 8 ft conference room. Behind them sit a common office of seven workstations, a pantry, twin toilets and a shared wash. Desks run along both long walls, so the aisle stays clear. This is the first size that reads as a corporate project office rather than a site cabin.
applications: Rs 17,85,600 ex GST, Rs 21,07,008 with 18 per cent GST
640 sq ft per floor, 1,280 sq ft gross, four stacked 8 ft bands
9 windows and 2 external doors per floor, service end solid
7 workstations, a manager room and a conference room per floor
Pantry, twin toilets and shared wash on both levels

panels.h3: 40 x 24 ft G+1: Reception, Cabins and a Six Desk Island
panels.paragraph: Twenty four feet of width lets the plan carry a front row of rooms and still hold an open floor. Each level runs a 10 x 8 ft reception, a 10 x 8 ft manager room and a conference room of the same size. Behind them sit fourteen workstations. Six of those form one island of three facing three. The service side adds a print store and a server room next to the pantry and the toilets. Choose it when clients visit the site office as often as staff do.
applications: Rs 26,78,400 ex GST, Rs 31,60,512 with 18 per cent GST

panels.h3: 40 x 32 ft G+1: The Largest Approved Two Level Plan
panels.paragraph: This is the full department floor, repeated. Four 10 x 8 ft rooms line the front wall on each level. Twenty workstations fill the open floor behind them, arranged in two islands of three facing three. A pantry, a sanitary group and four support rooms take the far end. Both floors carry twenty desks, so a project of eighty people on the ground can seat forty of them here. Every approved option in this family is two levels, and this is the largest of them.
